triples.tail_surface: engine room on Sea Breeze flooded
triples.evidence_text: The engine room on Sea Breeze flooded because valve A104 port, the single isolating butterfly valve between the port sea chest and the port ballast pump that was undergoing maintenance, was not fully closed prior to work commencing.

triples.head_surface: valve A104 port ... was not fully closed
triples.tail_surface: sea water entered the engine room through the exposed 15cm diameter ballast main
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 海水经暴露的压载总管进入机舱
triples.evidence_text: valve A104 port, the single isolating butterfly valve between the port sea chest and the port ballast pump that was undergoing maintenance, was not fully closed prior to work commencing. ... When the pump body was lifted clear of the pipe flanges, sea water entered the engine room through the exposed 15cm diameter ballast main.

triples.head_surface: chief engineer ... had not checked the valve position indicator
triples.head_canonical_zh: 轮机长未检查阀位指示器
triples.tail_surface: engine room on Sea Breeze flooded
triples.evidence_text: The chief engineer had attempted to close the valve and believed that it was closed, although he had not checked the valve position indicator before permitting work on removing the ballast pump to start.

triples.head_surface: worm and quadrant gearing ... could jam intermittently
triples.head_canonical_zh: 蜗轮扇形齿轮间歇卡滞
triples.evidence_text: the condition of the worm and quadrant gearing was such that it could jam intermittently. Such jamming caused the hand wheel to become tight, thereby giving the impression that the valve was closed when it was not.

triples.tail_surface: valve was closed when it was not
triples.evidence_text: Such jamming caused the hand wheel to become tight, thereby giving the impression that the valve was closed when it was not.
As required by SOLAS the valve was equipped with a position indicator, showing whether it was open or closed.

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 劳氏机械检验通用要求
triples.evidence_text: Ship side valves are required to be examined under the LR’s Machinery Surveys, General Requirements.

triples.tail_surface: Docking Survey, Hull and machinery requirements
triples.evidence_text: There is also a requirement to examine all sea connections and attached valves during docking surveys under Docking Survey, Hull and machinery requirements.

triples.tail_surface: ensure that these valves are fully reconditioned at this time and correctly assembled
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保阀门全面翻新并正确装配
triples.evidence_text: The inability to fully close sea connections has resulted in serious flooding of engine spaces. Surveyors must therefore ensure that these valves are fully reconditioned at this time and correctly assembled.

triples.head_surface: inability to fully close sea connections
triples.head_canonical_zh: 海水接头无法完全关闭
triples.evidence_text: The inability to fully close sea connections has resulted in serious flooding of engine spaces.
